text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, at the training track...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Phew, time for a little break.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek is known for her stamina, so
I'm
surprised she's out of breath from
running laps.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the concern, but I'm just
running a bit
hot thanks to this beautiful
weather.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you're worrying about me
though! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh gosh, thank you! Hehe! I'm all
energized now!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Please make sure you cheer your racer
on just as
enthusiastically, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Goodness me, thank you! You're so
considerate.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Have some of these in
return! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek gives me some handmade
cookies.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
They're my special carrot cookies. Go
ahead and
have them during your break.
